identity.name: Big Bang Unico
identity.one_liner: The 42mm Big Bang Unico flyback chronograph with Hublot's in-house HUB1280 caliber — the watch that defined the modern Hublot identity.

narrative.story: The Big Bang line launched in 2005 under Jean-Claude Biver; the Unico variant (2018) houses Hublot's in-house HUB1280 flyback chronograph caliber — a column-wheel, vertical-clutch movement with a 72-hour reserve. The 42mm titanium case uses Hublot's "Art of Fusion" construction: a layered case middle with exposed 6-screw bezel. The Big Bang Unico is the most-cited modern Hublot and the watch a collector cites when they want a flyback chronograph with a recognizable case design that is not a Daytona or a Royal Oak Offshore.
narrative.collector_notes: The HUB1280 is a Unico movement — Hublot's first fully in-house chronograph caliber (launched 2010). The flyback function resets and restarts the chronograph in one button press.
